     YOUR FIELD NOTES

    A woodland adventure

    1. Explore and collect.Open the walking map and allow location, or choose the practice grove. Meet critters within 80 m. Swipe or tap a Trail Woggle to invite a friend; Story cards and Golden Woggles build trust.
    2. Build your patrol.Take three critters into battle. Basic attacks and Guard build energy. At 3 energy, unleash a special move. A wild battle makes the catch easier.
    3. Earn your badges.Beat each trail’s trial to open the next habitat. Collect all eight patrol animals and all three badges to meet PartyPoss at the Great Oak.
    4. Discover places nearby.Spin supply stops within 80 m for camp items, then challenge Patrol Lodges for medals. Stops restock every 5 minutes. Open the book icon for the original trail campaign. Rest your patrol at Camp for free.

    Type advantages: Fire → Grass → Earth → Air → Water → Fire. Fairy is neutral. In encounters: Space to offer · B story card · U switch woggle · M Maui Wali.

    AR uses a live camera background. The camera icon saves a photo. The practice grove and trail book work offline after a full first visit. Live maps need internet access. Stop walking before interacting.

    An independent fan game. Not affiliated with Scouting America or Pokémon. Location is optional; choose the practice grove to play without GPS.
